answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before it can transact or vote. Creating one account is cheap, but creating ten thousand means locking ten thousand bonds, so the capital cost scales linearly while influence does not. The vault tracks each identity's reputation delta over time; proven fraud slashes the bond, making fake oasis accounts, many shells around one operator, an expensive, losing strategy.
